settings.title: AI assistant
settings.description: Connect your own AI service to get writing help in the editor. The service bills its usage to your account.
settings.noAccess: The AI assistant is available to editors and admins.
settings.notAvailable: AI is not set up on this server. An administrator needs to add AI_KEY_SECRET to the server settings.
settings.disabled: AI features are turned off for this installation.
settings.allowAllHint: When off, AI buttons disappear for all users. Stored connections are kept.
settings.providerOpenAiHint: Ollama on your computer, OpenRouter, Groq, Google Gemini and others.
settings.apiKeyOptional: API key (if the service needs one)
settings.keepKey: Leave empty to keep the stored key.
settings.presetHint: Prefills the address; check it against the service's documentation.
settings.disconnectText: Your stored key is deleted. AI buttons disappear until you connect again.

errors.baseUrlInvalid: Enter an http or https address

errors.AUTH: The AI service refused the key.
errors.RATE_LIMIT: The AI service is limiting requests. Try again shortly.
errors.UNREACHABLE: The AI service can't be reached. If you use Ollama, check that it is running.
errors.TOO_LONG: The text is too long for this model.
errors.TIMEOUT: The AI service took too long.
errors.AI_NOT_AVAILABLE: AI is not set up on this server.
errors.KEY_UNREADABLE: The stored key can't be read anymore. Connect again.
errors.AI_RATE_LIMIT: Too many AI requests. Wait a minute.
errors.NETWORK: Can't reach the server. Check your connection.
